name: identity

on_enter.text: Thank you. First, for security, what is your six-digit member code?

task_message: Ask the security questions one at a time: first the member code, then the month of birth. Call check_party once for each answer, with question member_code or birth_month. After every tool result, either speak to the customer or call the next tool: never end a turn with nothing. Call one tool per message. Follow what_to_do_next in a tool result.

function.name: check_party
function.description: Check one answer. CALL it every time the customer answers a security question.

function.name: end_call
function.description: Ends the call. CALL it right after you said goodbye, with no other text.
